description: Top-level Nexus profile catalog. A user-facing profile chooses an agent engine; engine-specific configuration remains in that engine's own registry. Existing Engineering Profiles are Dual-engine profiles. Muse is a separate agent plane and must never be coerced into Dual role semantics.

dual.description: Heterogeneous engineering flow using the existing role-based Nexus orchestration.

profiles.description: Muse Agent Plane foundation on the Contributor-tier model. Selection and execution stay disabled until the Meta provider and Muse V0 execution path are installed in later phases.
